title: Console welcome tour: compact screenshot + illustration snapshot set
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Produce a compact, re-usable set of screenshot compositions and lightweight illustration frames for the Console welcome tour. These assets will be used for the first-run experience, empty states for routes that require user setup, and the small contextual tip callouts shown during the guided tour. Focus areas: single-row hero snapshots for the tour carousel, two responsive empty-state variants (workspace-level and route-level), and three illustration treatments (flat icon, soft-gradient, and reduced-contrast for low-vision mode).
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains a page named 'Welcome Snapshot Kit' with organized components, variants, and export presets
Three illustration treatments exported at 1x/2x/3x PNG and optimized SVG with cleaning for small sizes
Tour carousel screenshots created at 1280x720 and mobile-safe crop 390x844, with overlay masks for live UI blur
Empty-state copy locked with approved microcopy from PM and included in localization-ready CSV
Accessibility checklist signed off: color contrast, alt text draft, keyboard focus order for tour modals
Developer handoff artifacts uploaded: export tokens, named assets, CSS snippets, and a design-to-engineering checklist
